description.value: The Chopped Leaf is a proudly Canadian fast-casual chain founded in 2009, now with 124+ locations, specializing in customizable salads, wraps, bowls, soups, and sandwiches built around fresh greens. The Surrey location on 56 Ave sits within a commercial area and offers a menu designed to feel like comfort food while staying health-forward. Touring cyclists looking for a quick, lighter meal stop would find a broad range of customizable options including a kids menu and signature dressings.
